name: Paattu
author: rajeevrama
description: Malayalam & Tamil music from YouTube playlists and profiles, with search across JioSaavn, YouTube and SoundCloud for songs, albums, singers and playlists: now-playing controls in the bar, a widget on the home workspace, and the Paattu app window. Audio streams through yt-dlp + mpv (no ads); library and playback live in the paattu command (~/.local/lib/paattu).

barWidget.description: Now playing with controls, the queue and Malayalam / Tamil mixes

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: Show the song and movie next to the icon, or just the icon.

schema.label: Label width
schema.description: Longest the label gets before it scrolls, in pixels.

schema.label: Scroll wheel
schema.description: Scrolling over the widget changes the volume, or skips tracks.
